what.text: This page follows refugees from Namibia living in Angola, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 1990, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 245 Namibian refugees in Angola, 46.1% of all refugees from Namibia that year.
Today, the United Kingdom hosts the most Namibian refugees, followed by Canada, Sweden and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Namibia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1980 to 1988.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 1976, at 5000 refugees, to 1990.
The figure was at its highest, 70010, at the end of 1982 and 1983.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Angola.
These are year-end totals for Angola only, reported to UNHCR from 1976 to 1990.
